name: Vibe MiniSentry
tagline: Lightweight error tracking and crash logging built with Claude Code
description:
A minimal, self-hostable Sentry-compatible event ingestion and crash logging server. Drops directly into existing Sentry SDKs to capture unhandled exceptions, stack traces, and environment tags.

Vibecoded end-to-end using Claude Code to show that teams don't need a multi-gigabyte Sentry cluster for simple crash alerting.

replaces.note: Drops into Sentry client SDKs with zero configuration and zero per-event pricing.
